description: This file defines a custom JPanel subclass called JPanelWithListener that manages MouseListener objects, allowing adding, removing, and clearing listeners and child components.

classes.name: JPanelWithListener
classes.description: A JPanel subclass that keeps track of MouseListener objects to allow for batch removal and management.

methods.name: JPanelWithListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with a specified layout manager.

methods.name: addMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to add a MouseListener and keep track of it in the internal list.

methods.name: removeMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to remove a MouseListener and update the internal list.

methods.name: removeAllMouseListeners
methods.description: Removes all stored MouseListeners from the panel.

methods.name: removeAllChildrenAndListeners
methods.description: Removes all child components and all mouse listeners from the panel.
